name: ar-v4
description: Local eyewear try-on with G Combined as the current base and preserved visual checkpoints.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p experiments/hair-live-preview/tsconfig.json && npm run check:stage3 && npm run check:speed-lab
scripts.build: npm run assets && npm run check && vite build --config vite.combined.config.ts
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/unit/*.test.ts experiments/hair-live-preview/*.test.ts experiments/hair-arm-preview/compose.test.ts && npm run test:speed-lab:unit
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config experiments/speed-lab/playwright.current.config.ts && playwright test && playwright test --config experiments/hair-live-preview/playwright.integration.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.build:performance: npm run assets && npm run check:performance && vite build --config experiments/performance-candidate/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:stage2: npm run assets && npm run check:stage2 && vite build --config experiments/performance-stage2/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:stage3: npm run assets && npm run check:stage3 && vite build --config experiments/performance-stage3/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:long-hair: npm run assets && npm run check && vite build --config vite.hair.config.ts
scripts.test:speed: npm run test:performance && npm run test:stage2 && npm run test:stage3
scripts.build:speed-lab: npm run assets && npm run check:speed-lab && vite build --config experiments/speed-lab/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:speed-lab: npm run check:speed-lab && npm run test:speed-lab:unit
scripts.build:test2: npm run assets && npm run check && vite build --config vite.speed.config.ts
scripts.build:efficiency: npm run assets && npm run check:efficiency && vite build --config experiments/efficiency-lab/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:efficiency: npm run check:efficiency && node --test experiments/efficiency-lab/*.test.ts experiments/efficiency-lab/hair-cost/*.test.ts experiments/efficiency-lab/native/*.test.ts experiments/efficiency-lab/temples/*.test.ts experiments/efficiency-lab/qa/*.test.mjs
scripts.build:mobile: npm run assets && npm run check:efficiency && vite build --config experiments/efficiency-lab/vite.mobile.config.ts
